newsitem.title: UK: BOE sets two separate rates at money mkt repos.
newsitem.headline: BOE sets two separate rates at money mkt repos.

text.p: The Bank of England set rates of 5-31/32 and 5-63/64 percent on repos and secured loan facilities starting on Thursday and maturing on March 6, 7 & 10 and March 20, 21 & 24 respectively.

The rate on the two week repo is the same as that currently applying to the Bank's day-to-day money market repos. The rate applying to the four-week repos is slightly higher for "purely technical reasons, reflecting the start of the Bank of England's new arrangements for open market operations on March 3," the Bank said.

"From that time the premium rate on the twice-monthly gilt repo facility, when it is offered, will be equal to the repo rate in the Bank's open market operations, which would be 6.0 percent were it operative now," the Bank said.
The Bank will announce the amounts to be allotted in the repos at around 1300 GMT.
